tactics.name: Lore teaser
tactics.goal: Attract fantasy and worldbuilding viewers with a Years of Ash fragment.
tactics.caption:
The Covenant between earth and sky broke. Star-shards remade the climate, the beasts, and the ore. What is left is the Years of Ash.

Manafall drops you on a procedural island ringed by dead kingdoms. Magic is the Four Breaths — Ember, Rime, Verdure, Hollow.

Read the world. Then try to live in it.
